sentences.zh: 噪音治理法似乎总是把矛头指向那些没有权力的人，那些其生计阻碍了

sentences.en: opinions were more of a concern to those in power.
sentences.zh: 更能受到当权者的关注。

sentences.en: This is very much both a literal and a sonic displacement.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上既是字面意义上的流离失所，也是声学意义上的流离失所。

sentences.en: The other problem with noise laws is that they aren't very effective.
sentences.zh: 噪音法的另一个问题是它们不是很有效。

sentences.en: So the way we currently regulate and measure sound in our communities is by using this decibel.
sentences.zh: 我们目前在社区中规范和测量声音的方法是使用分贝。

sentences.en: That's Erica Walker.
sentences.zh: 那是埃里卡·沃克。

sentences.en: Remember, the decibel measures how loud something is.
sentences.zh: 记住，分贝衡量的是声音有多大。

sentences.en: But most sound meters only
sentences.zh: 但大多数声级计只

sentences.en: listen to a specific range of frequencies, the kind that we hear with our ears.
sentences.zh: 监听特定频率范围内的声音，也就是我们用耳朵听到的那种。

sentences.en: That's called an A-weighted
sentences.zh: 这被称为A加权

sentences.en: system.
sentences.zh: 系统。

sentences.en: This A-weighted system that tells us that it's only the sounds that we process through the
sentences.zh: 这个A加权系统告诉我们，只有那些通过

sentences.zh: 听觉系统处理的声音才是重要的。

sentences.en: But there are some sounds we don't process with our ears.
sentences.zh: 但有些声音并不是用耳朵处理的。

sentences.en: Once the pitch gets low enough, we no longer hear it, but feel it instead.
sentences.zh: 一旦音高低到一定程度，我们就再也听不见它，而是能感觉到它。

sentences.en: It's completely vibrational.
sentences.zh: 这完全是振动性的。

sentences.en: So it's just essentially that feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以它基本上就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: So when you're in a community that's
sentences.zh: 所以当你身处一个位于航线下的

sentences.en: in a flight path and you say it's 65 A-weighted decibels, you're subtracting out the components
sentences.zh: 社区，你说那是65个A加权分贝时，你实际上剔除了

sentences.en: that come from the lower frequency sound.
sentences.zh: 来自低频声音的组成部分。

sentences.en: So you're leaving out a huge part of the story.
sentences.zh: 所以你遗漏了故事的很大一部分。

sentences.en: Not only is
sentences.zh: 这不仅是一个

sentences.en: it a flawed metric, they're using this metric to determine who's eligible for soundproofing
sentences.zh: 有缺陷的指标，他们还用这个指标来决定谁有资格获得隔音

sentences.en: criteria.
sentences.zh: 标准。

sentences.en: Erica is working on a project called the Community Noise Lab, and she hopes that by taking a much
sentences.zh: 埃里卡正在参与一个名为社区噪音实验室的项目，她希望通过将

sentences.en: wider range of frequencies into account, we can get a better grasp of how sounds are affecting
sentences.zh: 更广泛的频率范围考虑在内，我们能够更好地掌握声音是如何影响

sentences.en: our neighborhoods and our health.
sentences.zh: 我们的社区和健康的。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Kate Wagner says that there are steps everyone can take to make things sound a
sentences.zh: 与此同时，凯特·瓦格纳表示，每个人都可以采取一些步骤来让声音听起来

sentences.en: little better.
sentences.zh: 更好一点。

sentences.en: You can make acoustics changes to the spaces you're in.
sentences.zh: 你可以对自己所在的空间进行声学改造。

sentences.en: There are sort of architectural and
sentences.zh: 我们可以做出一些建筑和

sentences.en: design choices that we can make to make our spaces a little bit quieter.
sentences.zh: 设计上的选择，让我们的空间安静一点。

sentences.en: You can always choose to sort of
sentences.zh: 你总是可以选择

sentences.en: beef up the insulation or have a floating floor or any other sort of expensive solutions that are more
sentences.zh: 加固绝缘层、安装浮动地板，或者采取其他任何更具结构性的昂贵解决方案来

sentences.en: structural to isolating noise.
sentences.zh: 隔绝噪音。

sentences.en: You can also hang thicker curtains, which is cool because velvet is in.
sentences.zh: 你还可以挂更厚的窗帘，这很酷，因为天鹅绒现在很流行。

sentences.en: Velvet curtains might be a solution to noise problems in our home, but addressing the noise
sentences.zh: 天鹅绒窗帘可能是解决我们家中噪音问题的一种方案，但要解决

sentences.en: from cars and industry requires a fundamental change to the way we live.
sentences.zh: 汽车和工业带来的噪音，则需要对我们的生活方式进行根本性的改变。

sentences.en: Often, the things that are making the most noise, especially sort of industrial noise, are the things
sentences.zh: 通常，制造最大噪音的东西，尤其是那种工业噪音，往往是

sentences.en: that are perhaps not exactly the healthiest for the environment.
sentences.zh: 对环境最不健康的东西。

sentences.en: For example, it takes a lot more
sentences.zh: 例如，与拥有几乎完全无声的太阳能农场相比，

sentences.en: noise to have a natural gas plant or drill or do what have you for any kind of sort of extractive
sentences.zh: 运营天然气发电厂、钻探或出于任何开采目的进行

sentences.en: purposes than it does to have a solar farm, which is almost entirely silent.
sentences.zh: 各种操作需要产生大得多的噪音。

sentences.en: The quietest city I've ever been in that was a major city was Helsinki in Finland.
sentences.zh: 我待过的最大且最安静的城市是芬兰的赫尔辛基。

sentences.en: I was astonished
sentences.zh: 我感到非常惊讶，

sentences.en: because the metro or the subway trains and the buses and whatnot, they're silent.
sentences.zh: 因为地铁、地铁列车、公交车之类的是无声的。

sentences.en: The train stations
sentences.zh: 火车站

sentences.en: are very quiet.
sentences.zh: 非常安静。

sentences.en: That's partly because the majority of their trains are electric, but it's also down to the design of
sentences.zh: 这部分是因为他们的列车大多是电动的，但也归功于车站的

sentences.en: their stations.
sentences.zh: 设计。

sentences.en: From a mixture of materials, sound-absorbing materials, and also psychoacoustic tricks like
sentences.zh: 通过混合材料、吸音材料，以及诸如

sentences.en: pumping in noise that has this weird reverse effect of making things seem quieter, which is a technique
sentences.zh: 注入具有奇怪反向效果的噪音来让事情显得更安静的心理声学技巧（这也是

sentences.en: used in offices as well.
sentences.zh: 办公室里使用的一种技术），

sentences.en: The fins are able to make spaces quieter, and the idea that they should be
sentences.zh: 芬兰人能够让空间变得更安静，而且空间应该

sentences.en: quieter seems to be more popular there.
sentences.zh: 更安静这一理念在那里似乎更受欢迎。

sentences.en: Perhaps their quieter public spaces play a small part in
sentences.zh: 也许他们更安静的公共空间在使芬兰据称成为

sentences.en: making Finland, reportedly, the happiest country in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上最幸福的国家方面发挥了微小的作用。

sentences.en: It's a country that is so taken into
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常全面地照顾到

sentences.en: account the public good from all aspects.
sentences.zh: 各方公共利益的国家。

sentences.en: Things like health care, child care, social services,
sentences.zh: 诸如医疗保健、儿童保育、社会服务、

sentences.en: a robust welfare state, and things like their outlook on sustainability.
sentences.zh: 健全的福利国家，以及诸如他们对可持续发展的展望等事物。

sentences.en: So cleaner, quieter vehicles make you happier.
sentences.zh: 所以，更清洁、更安静的车辆能让你更快乐。

sentences.en: And when things are less noisy, there's a great
sentences.zh: 当噪音减小时，就有了极好的

sentences.en: opportunity to create a richer and more useful sonic landscape.
sentences.zh: 机会来创造一个更丰富、更有用的声景。

sentences.en: Electric cars don't naturally make a sound.
sentences.zh: 电动汽车天生不会发出声音。

sentences.en: So if you've ever had one creep up on you,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你曾遭遇电动汽车悄悄逼近，

sentences.en: it's a really, really scary experience.
sentences.zh: 那将是一次非常非常可怕的体验。

sentences.en: Joel Beckerman says this silence of electric cars can actually be a drawback.
sentences.zh: 乔尔·贝克曼表示，电动汽车的这种安静实际上可能是一个缺点。

sentences.en: Total silence is not a
sentences.zh: 绝对的安静并不是

sentences.en: good thing.
sentences.zh: 一件好事。

sentences.en: In fact, Joel says that electric cars need to make noise, or else they won't be safe.
sentences.zh: 事实上，乔尔表示电动汽车需要制造噪音，否则它们就不安全。

sentences.en: It's not for the people in the car.
sentences.zh: 这不是为了车里的人。

sentences.en: It's for the pedestrians to know that the car is coming.
sentences.zh: 这是为了让行知道汽车正在驶来。

sentences.en: But the opportunity is also to create a personality for the vehicle, for the electric vehicles.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一个为车辆、为电动汽车塑造个性的机会。

sentences.en: He actually worked with Nissan to create an identity for their new electric car.
sentences.zh: 他实际上与日产合作，为其新款电动汽车创造了一种身份特征。

sentences.en: Here it is coming right at you.
sentences.zh: 它正朝你驶来。

sentences.en: In this case, what we were looking to do was create a car that had a personality,
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我们希望做的是创造一辆具有个性的汽车，

sentences.en: which is really an association with clean energy.
sentences.zh: 这实际上与清洁能源息息相关。

sentences.en: One of the things we knew is it's going to be frictionless.
sentences.zh: 我们知道的一件事是它将是无摩擦的。

sentences.en: When you hear a car accelerate, if it accelerates very quickly, let's say,
sentences.zh: 当你听到汽车加速时，假设它加速非常快，

sentences.en: and there is a sense of really smoothness, lack of friction,
sentences.zh: 并且有一种非常平稳、缺乏摩擦的感觉，

sentences.en: there is almost a natural ambience to it.
sentences.zh: 它几乎有一种自然的氛围感。

sentences.en: We actually used natural sounds, but it still sounds like a car, and it absolutely had to,
sentences.zh: 我们实际上使用了自然的声音，但它听起来仍然像一辆车，而且绝对必须如此，

sentences.en: because we don't want pedestrians to hear it and say, oh, what's that, and get hit by the car.
sentences.zh: 因为我们不希望行听到它然后说，哦，那是什么，然后被车撞到。

sentences.en: Joel wants a future city dominated by natural sounds, but also sounds that we've consciously
sentences.zh: 乔尔希望未来的城市由自然声音主导，同时也由我们有意识地

sentences.en: chosen.
sentences.zh: 选择的声音主导。

sentences.en: Some cities are already taking a more thoughtful approach.
sentences.zh: 一些城市已经采取了更深思熟虑的方法。

sentences.en: In the Tokyo subway station, each station has a little tune associated with it.
sentences.zh: 在东京地铁站，每个车站都有与其相关的一段小曲子。

sentences.en: And if you know anything about the Japanese subway system, it is packed.
sentences.zh: 如果你对日本的地铁系统有所了解，就会知道它挤满了人。

sentences.en: So if you're in the middle of a car and you miss an announcement because it's noisy,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在车厢中间，因为嘈杂而错过了一次广播，

sentences.en: you're sunk.
sentences.zh: 你就完蛋了。

sentences.en: You're going to miss your stop.
sentences.zh: 你会错过你的那一站。

sentences.en: The Tokyo trains have a short jingle unique to each and every station along the line,
sentences.zh: 东京的列车在沿线的每一个车站都有独一无二的短促铃声，

sentences.en: like this one for Ikebukuro Station on the Yamanote line.
sentences.zh: 就像山手线池袋站的这一首。

sentences.en: These little tunes that show up at each station helps you understand where you are,
sentences.zh: 这些在每个车站出现的小旋律能帮你了解自己身在何处，

sentences.en: and also they're pleasing.
sentences.zh: 而且它们也很好听。

sentences.en: They're not a screamy announcement.
sentences.zh: 它们不是那种刺耳的广播。

sentences.en: We could live in cities full of intentional sounds, with soundscapes that we've chosen.
sentences.zh: 我们可以生活在充满有意设计的声音的城市中，拥有我们自己选择的声景。

sentences.en: You might find some of these new sounds really pleasant or really annoying.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得其中某些新声音非常悦耳，或者非常烦人。

sentences.en: But the nice thing is, you'll get to decide that for yourself,
sentences.zh: 但好消息是，你可以自己决定这一点，

sentences.en: because you'll be able to hear them all.
sentences.zh: 因为你将能够听到所有这些声音。
